name: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd
summary: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd engages in the custom synthesis and manufacturing of specialty chemicals in India, Europe, Japan, Singapore, China, North America, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Life Science related Specialty Chemicals and Performance Material. The company offers life science related specialty chemicals, such as agro intermediates and agro active ingredients for the agrochemicals industry; anti-bacterial and ultraviolet protection intermediates and ingredients for the personal care industry; and intermediates and key starting materials for active pharmaceutical ingredients.
